author: The Current
description:
Jimmy Jam describes how he and Terry Lewis worked with Janet Jackson to develop the album, "Control"
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Jimmy Jam reflects on working with Janet Jackson back in 1986 to develop what would become her album, “Control.” Jam says the album gave Jackson an opportunity to really express herself. “We were able to have conversations with her, and then take her ideas and put them into songs, which excited her.”

Hear more from Jimmy Jam in his and Terry Lewis’ interview with The Current’s Jill Riley in the video above. 

You can find Jam and Lewis’ complete interview here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bMhV5nKNH2E
